name: Pegasus Will

acquire.equipPiece: A single golden winged anklet on one ankle (a short white feather-tuft on a gold band) (the only equipped piece).

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form: the whole body becomes a Pegasus-humanoid in white-gold barding: horse head with a starlit white mane, two large feathered wings, a long white horsetail, golden-hooved digitigrade legs with hoof greaves and hoof-nailed hands; a thunderbolt lance of light forms in the right hand.

equip.weapon: A thunderbolt lance of white-gold light (Zeus's bolt) held in the right hand.
equip.armor: White-gold horse barding: winged pauldrons, a starlit chest plate, golden hoof greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: A long white mane tied with starlight, star-blue glowing eyes.
equip.aura: White-gold glow with falling star motes.

lore: A winged stallion of pure light whose hoofbeat can open a healing spring and whose gallop crosses the sky like a falling star.
pitch: Pegasus is the winged stallion of Greek myth that opened a spring with its hoof and carried Zeus's thunderbolts. Acquire keeps you human, galloping in star-trails with one golden winged anklet. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a horse-headed, winged beastman in white-gold barding with a bolt-lance, and costs a medium drain with a slow heal as your only mend.
untrained: An untrained holder is overwhelmed by the horse's urge to run: the legs bolt past the holder's control, falls hurt more and the healing spring refuses to open until the will is mastered. CANON ADDENDUM 2: the will lies dormant in the holder's mana core until it is forcefully awakened (a flame sparked in the core); if the holder cannot suppress and balance it, the clashing energies wreck body and core and can kill (design: strain climbs fast, backlash damage, forced cancel at the cap); mastery means training both the holder's own core and the beast core, best taught by the beast itself. This will summons no beasts or hordes.

spirit.echo: A tall winged stallion-man in white-gold barding on hoofed digitigrade legs: horse head, long white mane tied with starlight, large feathered wings, long horsetail, golden hooves, hoof-nailed hands, a bolt-lance of light.
spirit.look: A bright white orb with a tiny feathered wing outline inside and a small blue-gold star turning slowly above it.
